evidence.note: S490 will make a bounded read-only inspection of the already-authorized local CLO trial/account display to look for an affirmative rights grant; no terms acceptance, files, fixtures, uploads, or product changes.

text: S490 checks only visible version/license/trial scope in the pre-existing CLO installation. Stop at any new ToS, login, privacy, permission, payment, or contact gate. No file/project/fixture or exchange operation. Close CLO after the read-only check if no further authorized work is possible.
